en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.353 - A man from the Bedouins, who had servants and camels, came to the Messenger of Allah (sw) and said:

"O’ Messenger of Allah (sw), inform me about the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Glorious: 'Those who believe and are conscious of Allah (swt) — they will have good news in this world and in the Hereafter' (Surah Yunus 10:63-64)

The Prophet replied: "As for His words, 'They will have good news in this world,' it refers to the good dreams that a believer sees and is given glad tidings by them in this world. And as for 'and in the Hereafter,' it refers to the glad tidings a believer receives at the time of death, that Allah (swt) has forgiven you and those who carry you to your grave."
